verdict.rationale: The catalog says some downstream providers can be connected to your own account via OAuth. treg also stores credentials and injects them server-side, with a `treg health` check on credential status. Nothing in the pack shows encrypted vaulting or automatic token refresh, and the Claude-connector OAuth/PKCE item covers auth to treg itself, not downstream tools. missing for 10: documented treg-run OAuth flow mechanics for downstream tools, encrypted credential storage, automatic token refresh, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can let the platform run OAuth flows for downstream tools and vault the resulting credentials encrypted, with automatic token refresh
